description: Fetch the complete Markdown source of one Xianmi Library (xianmi.co) article by its path (e.g. "p01/a/109/764", as returned by search_texts). Includes the source URL and license pointer. Attribution required: see the license pointer included in every response.

lang.description: Language edition: zh-Hans = Simplified Chinese (default), zh-Hant = Traditional Chinese

path.description: Article path, e.g. "p01/a/109/764" (a full page URL also works)

name: get_passage
title: Get full text of a Xianmi Library page
